column1: I am a guy who does nothing but play games. I love the fact that I'm not a person who makes up games. I think that's what makes me a "gamer" and I think that's why the game industry works so hard to make it so that we can be as successful as possible.
But it's going to take a lot more than that.
I am always a fan of my friends and I think it's fantastic that they are gamers and I think they understand how we all feel about a game. I know that it's a small world. But it's a big world.

I understand that we have a lot of things to deal with. We are going to make mistakes, we are going to have a lot of things to deal with. We have a lot of things we are going to learn about, and we will learn. But you know what? I don't want to get too into the details of that.
Because I'm going to leave it at that.

The only thing I want to focus on is that I am a person who has never had a life in video games. I'm not a person who has spent any time on the internet, and I don't have a life in video games. I'm a person who has never had a life in video games.
I think video games are a small part of a larger world, a tiny part of a lot of the stuff that I think people think about. I think you have to be a man to be a gamer to play video games.
